specs.title: P18 actual overview routes to exact instrument/venue, compares reference quotes, loads lineage and navigates back
P18 self watchlist writes persist and all filters/empty guidance stay API-backed
P18 lost watchlist response locks original key/body/version and explicit retry recovers once
P18 self watchlist 409 keeps local edits and requires explicit latest-version review
P18 C16 market subscription preserves all other domains and severities after saved reload
P18 lost C16 reply reuses the exact committed subscription intent
P18 C16 conflict explicitly rebases market choice onto latest unrelated preferences
P18 per-venue failure keeps other quotes readable and an unlicensed selection has no price context
P18 wrong-dimension source response is isolated without leaking its price into detail
P18 readonly viewer cannot change watchlist; C16 remains a scoped personal preference contract
P18 offline clears quotes, subscription drafts and stream then explicit recovery only reads
P18 saved filters/layout persist only UI preferences, and recent visits stay in memory
P18 empty catalog, unknown symbol and malformed paths stay closed without fake prices
P18 selected quote feed disconnect freezes last fact; explicit resume binds its cursor
P18 overview/detail dark/light 1672/1024/390 visual and accessibility matrix
